project.name: FABRI-CORE Autonomous Sandbox
project.purpose: Aplicación Android con sandbox privado, terminal, entorno Linux opcional, agente IA, memoria híbrida SQL/FTS5/embeddings, catálogos, facturación/documentos, exportaciones y visualización de flujos en vivo.

design_system.style: dark premium technical interface, mobile-first, compact cards, high contrast, rounded corners, restrained glow, subtle animated particle wave

theme_rules: El color de acento es configurable en Ajustes y se aplica a navegación, estados, gráficas, botones y terminal; nunca debe alterar el contraste accesible.
Persistir el tema seleccionado en la base de datos local y restaurarlo al reiniciar.
Permitir elegir entre verde limón, morado, azul y amarillo oro; añadir vista previa antes de aplicar.

navigation.pattern: Bottom navigation for primary sections, independent full-screen routes for secondary workspaces

architecture.android_app: Kotlin + Android SDK; native navigation, permissions, lifecycle, notifications, theme, import/export
architecture.backend: Go service where feasible; local authenticated IPC/API bound to loopback or a safer app-private IPC mechanism
architecture.terminal: Integrate a compatible terminal emulator and process bridge; do not claim a terminal works unless real process I/O is wired
architecture.linux_sandbox: Optional downloadable Linux/Ubuntu userland only after validating architecture and PRoot compatibility; do not assume Termux packages work in a standalone APK
architecture.agent: OpenCode when supported by the selected runtime, using documented interfaces; provide adapter interface for other configured LLM providers
architecture.database: SQLite local source of truth; WAL where appropriate; versioned migrations; foreign keys; transactional writes
architecture.fts: SQLite FTS5 with startup capability check and indexed search for documents, products, invoices, project notes, and conversation memory
architecture.embeddings: Optional local embedding model downloaded on demand; persist vectors and metadata; vector search can begin with bounded in-process cosine search for small datasets; never claim semantic search when embeddings are unavailable
security: Store data in Android app-private storage by default
Use Android document picker for import/export instead of broad storage permission where possible
No public network binding by default
No API keys in APK source or frontend
Verify downloaded artifacts with trusted checksums/signatures when available
Do not auto-run untrusted remote scripts
Redact secrets from logs and indexing
persistence: Persist chats, tasks, installer state, projects, settings, brand configuration, invoice records, document metadata and catalog records
Recover resumable tasks after process death; revalidate destructive/non-idempotent operations before resuming
APK uninstall normally removes private data; explain and offer export/backup

rules: Limit parallel jobs according to available resources
Download models only on demand and show size/storage requirements
Use foreground service only when justified and compliant with current Android rules
Never promise 24/7 execution; explain Android background and battery limits
Show only metrics actually available to the app

screens.title: Panel principal
screens.purpose: Vista general del estado de FABRI-CORE.
layout: Header with logo and theme accent
logic: Refresh visible metrics at a conservative interval while foregrounded
Show unavailable metrics as unavailable, never fabricate values
Persist last selected project

screens.title: Chat IA / OpenCode
screens.purpose: Conversación con agente real y contexto recuperado.
logic: Retrieve relevant context via FTS5 and optional embeddings before agent call
Label answer provenance: OpenCode, configured LLM, local retrieval, or system result
Store message and source references transactionally
If agent unavailable, clearly state unavailable

screens.title: Terminal integrada
layout: Environment tabs: Android/runtime, Ubuntu, Build, Logs
actions: Clear view without deleting audit log
logic: Bind UI to real process stdin/stdout/stderr
Show working directory and execution environment
Do not present logs-only mode as interactive shell
Require confirmation for destructive actions

screens.title: Instalador y componentes
screens.purpose: Descarga e instalación verificable de módulos.
logic: Use resumable downloads when supported
Verify checksums/signatures where available
Persist progress
Never execute unverified scripts
Indeterminate progress if total size unknown

screens.title: Proyectos
logic: Use app-private project roots by default
Ask permission for imported external content
Never overwrite existing project without confirmation

screens.title: Base de datos
logic: Use parameterized queries
Require explicit confirmation for writes
Paginate large tables
Never expose secret columns by default

screens.title: Memoria RAG / vectorial
logic: Hybrid retrieval only if both text and vectors are available
Show provenance and score meaning
Never label raw keyword match as semantic result
Embeddings generated on demand and in batches

screens.title: Documentos indexados
screens.purpose: Catálogo de archivos y fuentes de conocimiento.
actions: Delete index or source with separate confirmations
logic: Track checksum and source URI
Avoid duplicate ingestion by checksum
Keep index deletion separate from source-file deletion

screens.title: Facturas guardadas
screens.purpose: Buscar, revisar y exportar registros de facturas.
logic: Keep original document separate from extracted metadata
Mark OCR confidence and require review for uncertain fields
Do not represent calculated tax data as official tax filing
Audit edits

screens.title: Análisis de datos
screens.purpose: Explorar métricas reales del sistema, proyectos, facturas e indexación.
logic: Derive KPIs from SQL queries with documented definitions
Show empty states when data is absent
Never use fabricated sample values in production

screens.title: Sistema y recursos
screens.purpose: Monitorización real del dispositivo y los servicios.
logic: Only display metrics the app can access
Distinguish app metrics from device-wide metrics
Avoid frequent polling in background

screens.title: Catálogo de productos
screens.purpose: Catálogo móvil independiente para buscar y consultar productos.
logic: Use paginated queries
Validate prices and stock
Show unavailable image fallback
Use configured brand identity in printable sheets

screens.title: Catálogo de documentos
screens.purpose: Catálogo independiente de facturas, manuales, contratos, fichas y documentos indexados.
logic: Respect document permissions
Keep original and generated exports distinct
Use Android share/document picker where appropriate

screens.title: Marca y configuración de documentos
screens.purpose: Generador de identidad visual y configuración de facturas/documentos imprimibles.
logic: Sanitize SVG and disallow scripts/external references
Validate PNG dimensions and size
Keep original asset
Embed or rasterize SVG safely for PDF renderer
Support left/center/right logo alignment
Preserve legibility and aspect ratio

screens.title: Exportación e impresión
logic: PDF for reports and print-ready documents
XLSX for spreadsheet analysis
CSV for interchange
Record export metadata without duplicating sensitive payloads in logs

screens.title: Flujos en vivo / cerebro de IA
screens.purpose: Visualización animada de la comunicación entre UI, backend, SQL, FTS5, embeddings, RAG, agente y proveedores externos.
logic: Render HTML/SVG/Canvas animation only from actual events
Differentiate live events from illustrative animation
Use WebSocket/SSE/local event bridge only if implemented
Do not display fake packet counts or fake data transfers
Reduce animation rate in battery saver

screens.title: Configuración
screens.purpose: Preferencias, proveedores, recursos, seguridad y copias de seguridad.
logic: Persist settings locally
Never expose API keys in logs
Warn before deleting models or data
Offer a full export before app removal

tables.name: app_settings
tables.purpose: Preferencias, tema, perfil de recursos y configuración no secreta

tables.name: document_fts
tables.purpose: Índice FTS5, sujeto a disponibilidad comprobada

tables.name: embeddings
tables.purpose: Vectores, modelo, dimensiones y vínculo al fragmento

tables.name: memory_items
tables.purpose: Memoria con procedencia, estado de verificación y retención

tables.name: brand_settings
tables.purpose: Identidad visual y datos de emisión documental

rules: No guardar binarios grandes directamente en tablas salvo justificación; almacenar archivos en el sandbox y metadatos en SQLite
Mantener ruta, checksum, tamaño, MIME type y fecha para cada archivo
Separar borrado de metadatos, índice y archivo original
Crear índices para los campos usados en búsquedas frecuentes

formats.PDF: Informes, fichas de productos, facturas registradas y documentos imprimibles
formats.XLSX: Análisis de tablas, productos, inventario, facturas y reportes
formats.print: Android Print Framework y selector de destino cuando sea compatible

requirements: Usar el logo y tema de marca configurados
Permitir seleccionar columnas y rango de fechas
Usar Android Storage Access Framework para guardar el archivo
No llamar factura tributaria oficial a un reporte interno

acceptance_tests: La APK compila en el dispositivo o informa de forma precisa qué dependencia falta
La base de datos persiste al cerrar y reiniciar la aplicación
FTS5 encuentra documentos de prueba si está disponible
La búsqueda vectorial solo aparece activa cuando existen embeddings utilizables
El selector de tema cambia todos los componentes y persiste
Se importa un logo PNG y SVG de forma segura y se muestra correctamente en la vista previa
Se exportan PDF, CSV y XLSX de datos reales
Los catálogos de productos y documentos tienen rutas independientes
El flujo animado refleja eventos reales y distingue claramente los estados sin conexión
Los trabajos de instalación conservan estado y errores
No se muestran estadísticas ficticias en producción
Se puede crear y restaurar una copia de seguridad de prueba
